verdict.rationale: The only related API evidence is that the Management API can order terminals and ship them to a chosen location. That is hardware procurement, not creating a store or location via API or registering and assigning readers to it. Terminal management is otherwise described only through the Customer Area UI, and the MCP server and OpenAPI repo are generic building blocks with no documented location-provisioning or reader-registration operations.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers
